decision.reason: [ev-ee55e6bf263f] is just a one-line PR title from the v2.0.0 "What's Changed" list: "v1.20 post release tasks". It doesn't name a component, setting, API or behaviour. It also gives no before/after, no condition for exposure and no consequence, and it only points to PR #6480 for details. To write the subject, change, applicability and consequence, we need the PR description or its diff, which would show what the tasks changed and whether any of it reaches users.
